# Be Your Best Self & Thrive Counseling

> A holistic counseling practice in St. Petersburg, FL offering mind-body-spirit therapy for anxiety, trauma, ADHD, and relationships with both online and in-person services.

Be Your Best Self & Thrive Counseling (BYBS) is a mental health practice founded on integrative, holistic approaches to therapy. The practice is led by experienced clinicians including Jamie Molnar (LMHC, RYT), Rochelle Young (LMHC), and Nicole Malene, and also operates a Training Institute for professional clinician development and supervision.

## Key Topics

- Holistic therapy
- Mind-body-spirit counseling
- Mental health counseling
- Individual therapy
- Couples counseling
- Anxiety treatment
- Trauma therapy
- ADHD counseling
- St. Petersburg, FL
- LMHC (Licensed Mental Health Counselor)
- RYT (Registered Yoga Teacher)
- Clinician training
- Professional development
- Online and in-person services
- Holistic mental health
